title: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents
summary: Convergent Detour Hijacking: Task-Preserving Resource Amplification in Skill-Based LLM Agents｜LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language description

extra.description: LLM agents increasingly rely on third-party skills, using natural-language descriptions for selection and instruction bodies for planning. This progressive-disclosure design exposes two sequential control points to untrusted publishers: a static skill may steer an otherwise correct task onto an unnecessarily costly trajectory.
